read_feishu_doc: read the full content of a Feishu/Lark document as plain text using its document token
build_feishu_doc_request: build a Feishu document raw content API request with GET method and tenant authentication
register_feishu_doc_tool: register the feishu_doc_read tool with the registry using schema, handler, and check function
check_feishu_dependency: check if the lark_oapi Python package is installed and available for import
set_feishu_client: set the lark API client in thread-local storage for use by feishu_doc_read handler
